title: CS-MT029-ClaudeSessionRecording

scope.summary:
GOAL: Durable, replayable recording of the Claude lane's session lifecycle: Flight Recorder events + ledger rows for launch / steer / ack / interrupt / resume with session + parent correlation, and transcript persistence of the full steering exchange — so the session's behavior is reconstructible from durable state alone (no chat history, no terminal scrollback), extending the existing WP-1 recording stack (FR-EVT-AGENT-* activity events, ProcessOwnershipLedger rows, session-transcript aggregator) rather than inventing a parallel one.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: new file src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/claude_session_recording.rs implementing the concrete recording sink the MT-023/024/025 seams call (replacing their interim no-op sinks); wiring in cli_bridge_runtime.rs; transcript-aggregator extension for steering-exchange rows; tests including a replay-reconstruction proof.

SPEC:
1. Event kinds come from MT-161 (recording/event-kind registry MT): this MT EMITS the MT-161-defined kinds for: session-launched (with preset fingerprint: argv sha256, bare_mode, role binding present), steer-injected (steer_seq, content_sha256), steer-acked (steer_seq, echo latency ms), steer-unconfirmed (steer_seq, timeout), interrupt-attempted/interrupt-outcome (MT-024 closed outcome set), session-resumed / session-forked (parent session_id correlation), session-ended (exit status, duration, total_cost_usd from the MT-022 result envelope). Kinds are consumed from MT-161's registry — never string literals minted here.
2. Correlation model: every event carries { handshake_session_id (MT-001), claude_session_id (from system/init / result), parent_claude_session_id (forks), parent_tool_use_id (subagent attribution from MT-022 ClaudeParsedLine), steer_seq where applicable }. This is what lets the transcript viewer and validators reconstruct WHO instructed WHAT and WHEN across forks and subagents.
3. `ClaudeSessionRecorder` implements the recording-sink traits established by MT-023 (SteerRecordingSink) and MT-024/MT-025's seams; construction requires the FlightRecorder handle + LedgerBatcher (mirroring the MANDATORY-ledger posture of LiveCliSpawner, official_cli_bridge.rs 577-588: no unattributed path). Recording failures follow the established emit_agent posture (cli_bridge_runtime.rs 270-282): log-and-continue for FR event emission — generation/steering is never blocked by a recording error — EXCEPT session-launched ledger registration which stays fail-closed (it already is, via the existing spawn path; this MT must not weaken it).
4. Transcript persistence: extend the session-transcript aggregator (the FR-EVT-AGENT -> SessionTranscriptEntry::AgentActivity pipeline named in agent_activity.rs mod docs, lines 8-11) so the steering exchange appears as ordered transcript rows: operator/orchestrator steer text (redacted via the existing SecretRedactor seam, cli_bridge_runtime.rs emit_agent_line signature line 300), ack status, interrupts, resume/fork boundaries. Ordering key: (turn ordering from the stream, steer_seq) — the transcript must show a steer BETWEEN the turns it actually separated (queued-own-turn semantics from MT-023).
5. Replay proof (HBR-INT-001/HBR-INT-007): an integration test drives a scripted session (fixture envelope stream + injected steers via the scripted-child harness from MT-023's tests), then reconstructs the session timeline PURELY from durable state (FR events + ledger + transcript rows) and asserts: launch fingerprint, 2 steers with ack latencies, 1 interrupt outcome, resume boundary with parent correlation, end with cost — byte-comparing the reconstruction against the expected timeline fixture. No in-memory state may be consulted by the reconstruction path.
6. Ids: all new record/event ids minted Uuid::now_v7() (HBR-INT-008).

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read the MT-161 event-kind registry, MT-001 session model ids, MT-023/024/025 sink traits, and the existing recording stack (emit_agent/emit_agent_line cli_bridge_runtime.rs 270-320; ledger START/STOP pattern official_cli_bridge.rs 2439-2490; transcript aggregator per agent_activity.rs mod docs).
2. Implement ClaudeSessionRecorder + correlation struct + kind mapping from MT-161.
3. Replace the interim no-op sinks in MT-023/024/025 wiring with the concrete recorder (one-line swaps left ready by those MTs).
4. Extend the transcript aggregator with steering-exchange row types (redaction-aware).
5. Tests: per-event-kind emission fixtures; correlation fields present on every kind; redaction applied to steer text; ordering test (steer lands between turns); recording-failure tolerance (FR emit error does not break steering); the replay-reconstruction integration test.
6. Live smoke (typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF when CLI/login absent): one real steered session; then reconstruct its timeline from durable state and eyeball-match the live transcript.
acceptance_criteria: All MT-161-defined Claude-lane event kinds are emitted at the right lifecycle points: launch (argv fingerprint), steer-injected/acked/unconfirmed (steer_seq + latency), interrupt attempt/outcome, resume/fork (parent correlation), end (exit status + total_cost_usd); kinds sourced from the MT-161 registry, zero locally-minted kind literals.
Every event carries the full correlation set: handshake_session_id, claude_session_id, parent_claude_session_id (forks), parent_tool_use_id (subagents), steer_seq where applicable.
ClaudeSessionRecorder replaces the interim no-op sinks of MT-023/024/025; construction requires FlightRecorder + LedgerBatcher (no unattributed recording path).
FR-emit failures log-and-continue (steering never blocked); session-launch ledger registration remains fail-closed and untouched.
Transcript rows show the steering exchange redacted and correctly ORDERED between the turns it separated (queued-own-turn semantics respected).

Replay-reconstruction test passes: the scripted session timeline is rebuilt from durable state alone and matches the fixture byte-for-byte; reconstruction provably consults no in-memory session state.
All new ids are Uuid::now_v7 (HBR-INT-008 grep proof).
Live smoke (or typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF): one real steered session reconstructs from durable state.
proof_targets: cargo test --manifest-path src/backend/handshake_core/Cargo.toml claude_session_recording -- --nocapture 2>&1 | grep -E 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed'

LIVE (type NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF if the claude CLI or operator login is absent): steer a real session twice, interrupt once, resume once; reconstruct from durable state; assert 2 steer-acked, 1 interrupt outcome, 1 resume boundary, terminal cost present
code_surfaces: src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/claude_steer.rs / claude_interrupt.rs / claude_resume.rs (no-op sink -> concrete recorder swaps)
implementation_notes: GROUNDING FACTS: the recording stack to extend already exists — FR-EVT-AGENT-* emission with log-and-continue posture (cli_bridge_runtime.rs emit_agent 270-282, emit_agent_line 290-320 with SecretRedactor), mandatory-ledger fail-closed spawn attribution (official_cli_bridge.rs 577-588, START row 2439-2454, STOP on every exit path 2462-2490), and the session-transcript aggregator named in agent_activity.rs mod docs 8-11. Reuse each; add no parallel recorder.

MT-161 owns the event-kind registry; MT-026 (role injection) already emits its own MT-161 kind — do not duplicate role-injection emission here, but DO include the role-binding fingerprint in the session-launched event for one-stop session identification.

Steer text in transcripts goes through the existing SecretRedactor seam exactly like tool-call inputs do today; the redaction test must prove a planted secret pattern in steer text is masked in the persisted row.
The replay test is the HBR-INT-001/007 acceptance surface: reconstruction must be a pure function of durable stores; enforce by running it against a freshly-opened store handle in the test.

MT-161/MT-001 seams absent = dependency-blocked (HBR-STOP-004); the interim no-op sinks in MT-023/024/025 stay in place until this MT swaps them (their contracts flag the no-op as a tracked deviation).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Durable recording layer; the session-timeline GUI/Argus surfaces consume these records in the WP-017 GUI MT group, where HBR-VIS applies.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Recording is internal wiring against MT-161's documented event kinds; the manual entry describing session-timeline inspection ships with the viewer surface MT.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: FlightRecorder: WIRED — this MT is the Claude-lane FR wiring itself (MT-161 kinds, correlation fields, redacted transcript).
internal_diagnostics: WIRED — recording-failure log-and-continue events and reconstruction test surface; ledger rows inspectable.
Palmistry: DEFERRED-with-reason — long-session health/heartbeat posture is the MT-005 supervisor's obligation; this MT records what the supervisor and transport report.
risk_if_missed: Steering exchanges exist only in process memory: no audit trail of who instructed a worker, no replay for validators, no parent/subagent attribution, broken HBR-INT-007 reconstruction — the governance value of the entire steering stack evaporates at the first session end.

risks: RISK-1: Recording is fire-and-forget into a sink that drops events under backpressure, so the durable timeline is subtly incomplete and replay reconstructions silently lie.
RISK-2: Steer text persisted unredacted leaks secrets (tokens, keys) that the operator pasted into a steering instruction, into durable transcripts.
RISK-3: Transcript ordering places steers at injection wall-clock time instead of between the turns they separated, so the replayed narrative misrepresents what the model actually saw when.
RISK-4: A second ad-hoc recording path (bypassing FlightRecorder/LedgerBatcher) creeps in for 'just this one event', forking the WP-1 recording architecture.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): the replay-reconstruction test asserts exact event counts against the scripted fixture; ack/unconfirmed states make delivery gaps visible rather than absent.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): SecretRedactor applied to steer text on the persistence path; planted-secret redaction test mandatory.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): ordering key is (stream turn order, steer_seq), test-pinned with a steer injected mid-fixture; wall-clock is metadata, never the sort key.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): ClaudeSessionRecorder is constructor-gated on FlightRecorder + LedgerBatcher; grep/review proof that no cloud-module event emission bypasses it or emit_agent.

corrections: The task brief's 'uses event kinds from MT-161' is honored strictly: this contract forbids locally-minted kind strings, so MT-161 must land (or export a stable registry) before this MT's sink swap — reflected in depends_on.
